raw_text_refs: Document authority: supersedes older FTAS sections that marked exact Monthly Status transitions as open.
Monthly Status is a persistent, evaluation-driven state machine.
All TFIS strategies consume Monthly Status before selecting the Bull, Bull CF, Bear or Bear CF strategy branch.
Monthly Status shall be calculated once upstream and consumed by all strategies; strategies shall not recalculate it.

authority_documents.normalized_rule: S21 consumes the upstream Monthly Status value from AB11, not an S21-specific recalculation.

normalized_rules.cmp_source_for_s21: Index Option Selling / Buying uses corresponding index spot/underlying price; for S21 this is BANKNIFTY spot/underlying.

parameters_for_banknifty.source: Monthly Status v1.0 segment parameter table: BANKNIFTY

routine_evaluation: Resolve strategy instance, segment, evaluation timestamp and authoritative CMP source.
Load previously established valid Monthly Status.
Resolve PMH, PML, PWH, PWL, CWH and CWL as of evaluation time.
Evaluate only transitions permitted from current state.
Persist transition if valid; otherwise retain previous state.
normalized_rules.equality: Bullish comparisons use >= and bearish comparisons use <=. Equality at threshold is a valid transition.
normalized_rules.missing_or_stale: UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE or missing required evidence fails closed before strategy branch selection.
normalized_rules.existing_generic_capability_mapping: Use one shared Monthly Status service before branch resolution.
